name: Death Connection
source:
On a rainy night, a woman brought a baby to a church in the country and left her to the priest... The priest named her Amelia... Seventeen years later, Amelia was living happily with the priest and Joshua. But one night, a group of gangsters suddenly came into the church to kill Amelia. Amelia and Joshua somehow run away and meet a guy who frequently visits the church. He takes them to a house and gives them a pendant. When Amelia held it, it suddenly shined and three guys appeared. They are Vicious, Nicole and Leo...

[Edited from HimeyaShop]
translation:
一个雨夜，一名女性把婴儿带到乡间教堂，将她留给神父…神父为她取名阿梅莉亚…十七年后，阿梅莉亚与神父和约书亚幸福地生活在一起。然而某天夜里，一群黑帮分子突然闯入教堂，企图杀死阿梅莉亚。她与约书亚设法逃走，遇见一名经常造访教堂的男子。男子把两人带到一栋房子，并交给他们一枚吊坠。阿梅莉亚握住吊坠后，它突然发出光芒，三名男子随之出现。他们是维夏斯、尼科尔与雷欧…
